class_meanings.stable: Code family is part of the 0.38 connectivity / foundation envelope. Existing codes keep identity; incompatible renumbering or removal requires migration notes.
class_meanings.provisional: Public and emitted today, but the family may change before a later explicit graduation (aligned with provisional wire/protocol surfaces).
class_meanings.experimental: May change or be removed without a 0.38 Beta compatibility obligation.

notes: Family = alphabetic prefix of a shipped diagnostic code (trailing digits stripped).
PMCONN covers connector protocol, binding, landing-zone, and publication diagnostics introduced in 0.38.
PMCP covers control-plane identity, authorization, and submission diagnostics incubating in 0.39 CP1 (provisional until CP1 exit).
PMID covers IDE/static-analysis workspace diagnostics introduced in 0.44 (experimental while Developer Intelligence incubates).
PMQTY is provisional while etlantic.quality/1 remains provisional.
ODCS/DTCS/DPCS codes retain their upstream namespaces when present; declare a tier here before shipping new ETLantic-owned families.
PMOPT covers optimization-pass diagnostics introduced in 0.45 (stable with etlantic.optimization/1).
PMDYN / PMSTR / PMDLQ / PMREG cover 0.46 dynamic expansion, stream semantics, record-error/DLQ, and schema-registry diagnostics.
